steps.title: 模拟Ping Pong游戏计算获胜概率

args.code:
import random
def simulate_game():
    ramp = list(range(1, 101))
    platform = ramp[:3]
    ramp = ramp[3:]
    while True:
        piston = random.randint(0,2)
        ejected = platform[piston]
        return ejected
        if piston == 0:
            platform = platform[1:] + [ramp.pop(0)]
        elif piston == 1:
            platform = [platform[2]] + ramp[:2]
            ramp = ramp[2:]
        else:
            platform = [platform[1]] + ramp[:2]
            ramp = ramp[2:]
counts = [0]*101
N = 100000
for _ in range(N):
    ball = simulate_game()
    counts[ball] += 1
max_count = max(counts)
max_ball = counts.index(max_count)
print(f"最高概率的球是{max_ball}，概率是{max_count/N:.4f}")
